title: 云原生 Agent 沙箱与企业 AI 运维应用
english: The supplied sources highlight two developments relevant to infrastructure and operations. CNCF describes OpenKruise Agents as a sub-project of OpenKruise that provides lifecycle management for Agent Sandboxes running at scale on Kubernetes. Its article title identifies version 0.6.0 and focuses on sandbox security and automation, but the supplied summary does not specify the release changes. Separately, OpenAI reports that Cisco combines network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security and build more adaptive defenses. Together, these items point to two operational concerns: managing agent workloads on Kubernetes and applying AI to security workflows. The available summaries do not provide implementation details, performance measurements, or evidence for comparative claims, so those should be verified from the original articles before drawing further conclusions.
chinese: 提供的来源显示了两个与基础设施和运维相关的方向。CNCF 将 OpenKruise Agents 描述为 OpenKruise 的子项目，为大规模运行在 Kubernetes 上的 Agent Sandbox 提供生命周期管理。文章标题提到 v0.6.0，并聚焦沙箱安全与自动化，但所给摘要没有说明该版本的具体改动。另一则 OpenAI 新闻称，Cisco 将网络情报与 OpenAI 模型结合，以增强企业安全并构建更自适应的防御。现有摘要支持关注 Kubernetes 上的 Agent 工作负载管理及 AI 安全工作流，但未提供实现细节、性能数据或比较依据；进一步判断应查阅原文。
why_it_matters: 对云原生与 Agent Infra 从业者，Agent Sandbox 的生命周期管理及其安全、自动化是值得跟踪的基础设施议题。对 AIOps 与安全运维而言，Cisco 案例说明网络情报与模型可被组合用于防御，但来源未披露具体架构或效果。职业发展上，可重点积累 Kubernetes 工作负载管理、沙箱安全和 AI 安全系统评估能力，并以原始资料核实实践细节。
interview_expression: I would evaluate agent infrastructure across lifecycle management, sandbox security, and operational automation. For AI-assisted security, I would verify the implementation details and measured outcomes before making claims about effectiveness.
